get_classes_by_dataset: get the class names list for a segmentation dataset like cityscapes or ade20k by name
get_palette_by_dataset: get the RGB color palette for a segmentation dataset like voc or cocostuff by name
cityscapes_classes: get the list of 19 class names used in the Cityscapes semantic segmentation dataset
ade_classes: get the list of 150 class names used in the ADE20K semantic segmentation dataset
voc_classes: get the list of 21 class names used in the Pascal VOC semantic segmentation dataset
